events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between Iran and the US has escalated, with reports of increased military activity in the region. This has led to a surge in oil prices and a decrease in stock markets. The situation is highly volatile and unpredictable.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict in Iran has led to a significant increase in oil prices, making oil services stocks more attractive. On the other hand, the uncertainty and volatility in the market make it a good time to short the S&P 500.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict de-escalates or if the oil prices drop significantly

gains.conservativeNote: If the conflict continues at the current level
gains.extendedNote: If the conflict leads to a significant disruption in oil supplies
